notes.title: New updates in build 1.0093
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

How's going?

In [url=https://discordapp.com/channels/583183485712203776/590424772706304022]discord discussion[/url], we had a survey about the magic spell casting system.  The conclusion is more people wanted a direct casting system, so we've changed it in this week.  But don't worry, we still keep the old system so that hard core players won't miss it.  And we have to restore the settings to default in order to perform it, sorry about this.

In the settings, you 'll notice the change below:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34096850/70f14ae6a4ffa4a1a72be7887d4adb48227ce521.png[/img]

Simple spells means cast the magic directly.  Rune spells means old magic casting sytem, swith to the system you like.

The simple spells casting system in the game looks like this:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34096850/998142950ce11463396bec6db23120ff1e64ff38.png[/img]
Colorful icon means you've learned the spell and is able to cast, gray icon means you need to learn it first by adding more points to the skill.  Click on the arrow button below will turn the page and show more spells.

Of course, left click on the magic icon will cast the magic and right click will save the magic spell to your quick-casting button without casting it.

And at the first time you cast a magic spell, you'll see the magic spell name in the center of the screen.

Check out this video to get more information:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1836135702]New Magic Spell Casting System[/url]

notes.title: Today is the last day ...
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34096850/b108823046afd83cd0df77088502b4528c087ee5.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

    HexGameStudio is a very small game studio with 5 people currently, and there is only one programmer in the team, who is writing code, doing marketing and project management.  Yes, this is me and I'm still working, now is 1:40 AM on my side, I'm excited.  
    
    Since the beginning, we've updated the game from build version 1865 to 2493,  and as we've promised we are going to release the game officially, there are still some bugs and functions missing, though.  We are trying the best!

    Thank you so much for those people helping us during the EA stage, we really appreciate your contribution here.  Especially helping us to express the culture of dungeon crawler's games.  We love this kind of games since we are very young.  The grid based system provides so much fun in my childhood, I want to bring the feeling back when I still can.

    I know the game is going to receive a lot of negative reviews (or no one cares), but the experience of making the game and having fun discussion with the crawlers is good enough for me.

    Today is the last day that you can get DODK by $7.19.  You can try and then refund if you don't like the game, but it is the best chance to get DODK with the lowest price so far.

    Have fun, my friends!

Best Regards,
HexGameStudio
Hector Xiang

notes.title: New updates in build 2448
notes.notes:
Hi players,

In this half of year, we've been trying the best.  Even though we are a very small indie development team, which has only one programmer one designer and one artist, we have been working very hard.  Because we are building something that we have been loving since our childhood, we are very happy.

Dungeon Of Dragon Knight is the first game of our game studio, as well as the first game put on STEAM, hopefully not the last.  We did encounter a lot of problems and did make many bugs.  But we are so lucky to have your help go through them and get the game better and better.

Take a look at the game, it is much better than we expected at beginning.  Without your help, we cannot make it.

Thank you, my fellows.  Wait and see more content and features.

HexGameStudio

notes.title: Now we can update the game, build version 2417
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34096850/6797aff82efbb664c86164cca66ae9e5d55fb33d.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34096850/3a8f87e6e28b5e9e7f081b0475a54f8bb253f9e1.png[/img][/url]

[b][u]If you have any question, please post in discussions, not here.[/u][/b]

Last week we've encountered some network connection issues and couldn't upload any file to the server.  Sorry that we didn't update anything during the time.  But now we figured out a way to update the game, so here we go.


We've built a guide inside the game, so you don't have to complain how to split items that can be piled.  Battle now is much more balancing and we fixed some translation errors for Korean.

Difficulty has already been done and you can select it in the beginning menu.  Easy mode removes hunger system for your convenience, but not lowing down the combat of the original build, if you are in the middle of the game and not willing to restart the game.

Hope you'll have fun in this update.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34096850/9634a2c7235b2e9313a3802633154f67e8acbe32.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Game Is Still In EA stage!
notes.notes:
Hi guys, 

I'm very sorry that the store changed to official release by an unknown problem.  Unfortunately it happened again.  We asked STEAM to fix it again.

Good news is we've added French version and some funny props.  And the most important, we've released OST, which is made by Mr. Shibata, who has made some very good music for Monster Hunter, Resident Evil and Devil May Cry.  Please check it out if you like.

Again, sorry for the mistake, we don't know why it happened.  But the game will be officially released on 10 July, hope it would never happen during the time.

HexGameStudio

You can also find English editor tutorial in the guide catagory and I've posted several video to show how to use in the videos catagory.  The editor is very easy to use.
